question: Which author wrote the popular novel 'Held', shortlisted for Booker 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anne Michaels**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Anne Michaels** is a Canadian poet and novelist known for her profound exploration of themes like memory, loss, and identity.
 
• Her novel **'Held'**, shortlisted for the Booker Prize 2024, continues her tradition of blending poetic language with compelling storytelling.
 
• Anne Michaels previously gained global recognition with her novel **'Fugitive Pieces'**, which won multiple prestigious awards, including the Orange Prize for Fiction.
 
• 'Held' has been praised by critics for its intricate narrative and emotionally resonant prose, solidifying her status as a literary powerhouse.
 
• Michaels’ works are widely celebrated for their ability to delve into universal human experiences while maintaining a personal and intimate tone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Booker Prize:**

 
 
• One of the most prestigious literary awards, established in 1969, recognizing outstanding original novels written in English.
 
• The award is open to authors of any nationality, provided the work is published in the UK or Ireland.
 
• Past winners include literary greats such as Salman Rushdie, Margaret Atwood, and Kazuo Ishiguro.
 
 
 
• **Anne Michaels’ Writing Style:**
 
 
• Her works often blend poetry and prose to create rich, textured narratives.
 
• Michaels is known for her meticulous attention to language, crafting sentences that resonate deeply with readers.
 
• Recurring themes in her work include history, memory, trauma, and the enduring nature of human connection.
 
 
 
• **Fugitive Pieces:**
 
 
• Anne Michaels’ debut novel, which explores the Holocaust through the lens of memory and survival.
 
• The book has been translated into over 20 languages and adapted into a feature film.
 
• It won several awards, including the Orange Prize for Fiction and the Guardian Fiction Prize.
 
 
 
• **Booker Prize 2024:**
 
 
• The shortlisted works for this edition of the prize represent diverse voices and innovative storytelling.
 
• It demonstrates the global reach and influence of contemporary English literature.
 
• The winner will be announced later in the year, with the shortlisted novels gaining immense critical and commercial attention.
